messages:
Michelle Chen: Heads up — VoltChip asked to run an energy-efficiency bakeoff next Tue for the Neuron-512 board. Goal: perf/W and p99 throughput under our micro-load. Can folks confirm the test harness and acceptance criteria?
Ravi Patel: I can own the harness. Plan: three passes — cold start, KV-warm, steady-state. Metric = tokens / joules over 1M tokens. Need VoltChip to expose board-level power counters and a consistent clock governor.
Jordan Lee: I will prep kernel tuning + patchset. We'll capture perf counters + board PMBus traces. Example command we'll standardize on:
```
perf stat -e power/energy-pkg/,power/energy-cores/ -o energy.log -- ./run_infer --model llama-v2-7b --seq 512 --tokens 100000
```
And we'll normalize to the same token mix.
Andi Morales: Agreement on dataset/token distribution is critical. Suggest: mix = 60% short (<32), 30% mid (32-128), 10% long (128-512). Also prefill normalization: do a 128-token warmup then start energy accounting for 10k tokens.
VoltChip Ops Bot: VoltChip: we can provide PMBus + per-board telemetry. We'll expose i2c interface for real-time sampling and a CSV power dump post-run. Need lab contact for firewall ACLs.
Michelle Chen: Two asks for announcement gating: 1) >= 15% perf/W improvement vs our current prod baseline (same model/config); 2) reproducible run artifacts (raw energy traces, kernel git hash, run script). Timeline: dry-run Fri, formal run Mon next week.
Ravi Patel: I'll drop an experiment checklist + telemetry schema in `redwood/partner-bakeoffs/voltchip/` by EOD today. Telemetry keys: `partner`, `board_rev`, `kernel_git`, `power_interface`, `run_type`, `seq_distribution`.
Jordan Lee: Kernel knobs to sweep: L2 prefetch, CPU governor (`performance` vs `schedutil`), IO affinity, hugepage on/off. Also try a micro-Patch that disables preemption for critical threads. I'll include patchset id in the results.
Andi Morales: Marketing asked for a short co-branded one-pager. Can engineering promise a preliminary summary by Wed? :thinking_face:
Michelle Chen: If dry-run is clean, yes. If not, we hold the blurb. @VoltChip Ops Bot please DM lab-ops contact and cc me.
VoltChip Ops Bot: DM sent to lab-ops@voltchip.com with request for port ACL and PMBus credentials.
Ravi Patel: Scheduling a 30m sync Wed 11:00am PT to review dry-run artifacts. Agenda: run script, raw energy logs, perf/W calc, anomalies, and marketplace blurb draft.
Jordan Lee: I'll attach GPU kernel logs, `/sys` rails snapshot, and the kernel `dmesg` output to the repo. Expect ~2-3 short follow-ups during the runs.
Michelle Chen: Thanks — I'll author the checklist and tag marketing for the one-pager once engineer signoff on dry-run. :rocket:
